Additionally, Methimazole is also linked to Dibromotyrosine, another marker of Thyrotoxicosis, which is also associated with Hyperthyroidism. These pathways indicate that Methimazole may contribute to the development of Hyperthyroidism through its role in inducing Thyrotoxicosis. The strong scores from both paths suggest a consistent and significant relationship, though the exact mechanism by which Methimazole influences Thyrotoxicosis and subsequently Hyperthyroidism remains to be fully elucidated.
